detail: round-1 cold spec-judge blocked: the negative scenario named one member (draft) of the unfrozen class, the dropped location permutation left a folder-scoped implementer uncaught, one Given failed to pin the dependents freeze state, the trigger read touched where the ratified keep reads changes, D was defined as depends-on which ADR-0021 rules is four relations, and a negative Then contradicted a frozen sibling scenario. Remediated by re-anchoring D to frozen-assertion-about-the-artifact and narrowing the trigger to a behavioral change.

round-2 cold spec-judge blocked and named two of its blockers as regressions introduced by the round-1 remediation: the derived qualifier is unobservable because the followup line schema carries no origin field, and the README cell imported a per-node lifecycle status that lifecycle-governance says no node may carry. Two further blockers strike the design itself rather than its expression.

why.floor: none — no hard floor fired; this is the remediation-governance regression stop, not a Clearance, Compatibility, or Conflict escalation
why.blast: low as scoped, but the round-2 findings show the ratified behavior cannot be specified within that scope: a computable D needs the ADR-0021 cross-reference resolver, which is an unbuilt engine in another capability
why.novelty: high in the unplanned dimension — the CR was scoped as a codification of a ratified keep and turned out to require a design decision the keep never settled
why.confidence: high that the stop is correct: two round-2 blockers were verified first-hand against the primaries (the followup schema carries no origin field; lifecycle frontmatter is root-spec.md-only), and remediation-governance stops the loop for a re-plan when a finding names an artifact the previous round changed
